typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT LEFT((CAST((SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112) ) AS VARCHAR)+\'START\'),79) AS TRIG_FILE',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBTRIGGER
SRCOLEDBTRIGGER sink(input(
		TriggerFILE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TriggerFILE = TRIG_FILE)) ~> DSTFFTRIGGER
